caption_en: In the 1920s Zagreb's population grew by 70 percent. New housing estates went up at the edge of the city.
caption_sv: U 1920-ima broj stanovnika Zagreba porastao je za 70 posto. Na rubu grada nicala su nova stambena naselja.

caption_en: In Maksimir, the Railway Colony: rows of houses with gardens for railway staff, beside the line where most of them worked.
caption_sv: U Maksimiru, Željeznička kolonija: kuće u nizu s vrtovima za željezničare, uz prugu na kojoj je većina njih radila.

caption_en: It was planned in 1923 and built by 1927. The City's heritage register dates it 1923, so on this map it stands from that year.
caption_sv: Planirana je 1923., a izgrađena do 1927. Gradski registar zaštite datira je u 1923., pa na ovoj karti stoji od te godine.

caption_en: In Trešnjevka, the estate of the Prva hrvatska štedionica savings bank was built in 1934 and 1935.
caption_sv: Na Trešnjevci je 1934. i 1935. izgrađeno naselje Prve hrvatske štedionice.

caption_en: Ivan Meštrović designed this round exhibition hall, built in 1938 on today's Square of the Victims of Fascism.
caption_sv: Ivan Meštrović projektirao je ovu okruglu izložbenu dvoranu, sagrađenu 1938. na današnjem Trgu žrtava fašizma.

caption_en: It was later a mosque and then the Museum of the Revolution. Since 1990 it has been the artists' house again.
caption_sv: Kasnije je bio džamija, a zatim Muzej revolucije. Od 1990. ponovno je dom likovnih umjetnika.

caption_en: In 1939 the architect Vlado Antolić planned Cvjetno naselje, the first planned estate by the Sava. Its houses date from 1939 and 1940.
caption_sv: Arhitekt Vlado Antolić osmislio je 1939. Cvjetno naselje, prvo plansko naselje uz Savu. Kuće su iz 1939. i 1940.
photo_caption_en: Cvjetno naselje in 2014, with later towers behind
photo_caption_sv: Cvjetno naselje 2014., iza njega kasniji neboderi

caption_en: After the First World War the city reached towards the Sava, and the first embankment was built along the river.
caption_sv: Nakon Prvoga svjetskog rata grad se približio Savi, a uz rijeku je izgrađen prvi nasip.
